info.title: Grimes Engravers catalogue
info.description: Read-only data about Grimes Engravers Ltd (Cardiff, est. 1947): engraved glass and crystal awards (minimum order 2 in total) and memorial bench plaques. Prices are 'from' prices per award before engraving; engraving and delivery are confirmed in a quote by email within 24 hours. To order, send the customer to the quote page.
